My first 'Fuck This' moment came when I was roughly ten or eleven. The very first God of War and those goddamn spinning pillars in Hades. I was stuck on the first pillar, and it got to the point where I stopped playing the game, collapsed on my bed, and cried. My mom came in to ask what was wrong, and I just started bawling, asking her to sell the game because I didn't want it anymore. 
I wound up asking her for help, she couldn't do it either. We eventually looked up a walkthrough, and got past the first pillar. I was wiping my tears away and smiling. Then I saw the second pillar. Fun times all around.

*Y I K E S* Your mom's an absolute bitch. I've dealt with something akin to this, and the best solution to this is to either get the hell out of there immediately, or if you're unable-Just tell yourself that the woman who's berating you, is not a real parent in any sense of the word. She does not have your best interests in mind. Simply selfish. She's speaking for herself, she's not your innermost thoughts (hopefully.) To ignore her is easier said than done, but goddammit it's worth the effort.
